weights.label: Adventure · 2023
weights.basis: 2023 Adventure: 473 lb claimed curb weight in Cycle News launch review. Mass preset only; dyno runs keep their tested model.

weights.label: Adventure R · 2026 OEM
weights.basis: 2026 Adventure R: KTM specifies 215 kg fully fueled. This mass preset does not turn an older run into a 2026 dyno test.

weights.label: Duke R · 2020 measured
weights.basis: 2020 Duke R: Cycle World measured 406 lb wet. Duke and Adventure engine calibrations differ; select the matching tested run separately.

weights.label: GS Adventure · OEM
weights.basis: BMW R 1300 GS Adventure: 593 lb road ready, standard equipment, operating fluids and at least 90% usable fuel capacity.

weights.label: 800 · 2026 OEM

weights.label: SM · 2025 OEM

weights.label: SM · 2024 OEM
